description: Create a customer in AbaNinja. Either a company (name required) or a person (first_name + last_name). Optional: customer_number, vat_number, currency_code, language, payment_terms, and an address (street, zip, city, country_code). Returns the created record including its uuid. Does NOT check for duplicates first — run compare_customers or get_abaninja_customer if you might already have this customer, because AbaNinja will happily store the same firm twice.

country_code.description: e.g. CH (default CH for a 4-digit zip)

customer_number.description: Customer number to assign in AbaNinja

state.description: Canton, e.g. ZH. Optional for Swiss addresses — derived from the zip when omitted.

type.description: company (default, name required) or person (first_name + last_name)

name: create_abaninja_customer
